description: This file defines the Analytics controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It handles listing, installing, and uninstalling analytics extensions within the admin panel, including managing permissions, loading views, and interacting with models.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing analytics extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing available extensions, and performing install/uninstall operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of analytics extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares data for the analytics extension list view, including available and installed extensions, permissions, and links to manage each extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a specified analytics extension, including permission checks, file existence verification, and setting up the necessary configurations and permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a specified analytics extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
